characters_pool_check.name: characters_pool_check
characters_pool_check.value: "characters"."pool_started_at" is null or ("characters"."pool_rates" is not null and "characters"."pool_place" in ('field', 'hub', 'study-hall', 'dorm'))

economy_ledger_coalesced_check.name: economy_ledger_coalesced_check
economy_ledger_coalesced_check.value: "economy_ledger"."entries" >= 1 and ("economy_ledger"."coalesced" or "economy_ledger"."entries" = 1) and not ("economy_ledger"."coalesced" and "economy_ledger"."item_id" is not null)

economy_ledger_item_check.name: economy_ledger_item_check
economy_ledger_item_check.value: ("economy_ledger"."item_id" is null) = ("economy_ledger"."currency" not like 'item:%') and ("economy_ledger"."item_id" is null or "economy_ledger"."amount" in (1, -1))

items_tool_check.name: items_tool_check
items_tool_check.value: "items"."kind" = 'book' or ("items"."level" <= 5 and "items"."grade" = 0 and "items"."pilgi" = 0 and "items"."pilgi_fail_streak" = 0 and not "items"."evolved")

listings_item_check.name: listings_item_check
listings_item_check.value: ("listings"."item_id" is null) = ("listings"."item" is null) and ("listings"."item_id" is null or "listings"."listed_qty" = 1)

trade_log_board_check.name: trade_log_board_check
trade_log_board_check.value: ("trade_log"."kind" = 'board') = ("trade_log"."listing_id" is not null and "trade_log"."def_id" is not null and "trade_log"."grade" is not null and "trade_log"."qty" > 0 and "trade_log"."unit_price" > 0)
